source_note_cell_inventory.text: (1) Bei Öko-Regelungen im Rahmen der Direktzahlungen werden die für diese Maßnahmen zugeteilten Mittel im Rahmen der
in den Maßnahmen vorgegebenen Prämienbänder in Abhängigkeit der beantragten Flächen bzw. GVE aliquot aufgeteilt,
garantiert ist dabei der angegebene Mindestbetrag.
1) Jeweiliges Grünlandausmaß multipliziert mit den Faktoren: Mähwiese/-weide (ab 2 Nutzungen) und Dauerweide mit 1,0; Mähwiese 1 Schnitt, Hutweide,
2) Ausgenommen Ackerfutter; einschließlich Nützlings-, Blühstreifen und Biodiversitätsflächen.
3) In den ausgewiesenen Gebieten liegende Mähwiesen und Mähweiden mit mindestens 2 Nutzungen sowie Dauerweiden, alle mit Hangneigung <25%.
5) Die Prämien sind in einem Modulsystem bestehend aus über 300 Einzelbausteinen festgelegt.

source_explanations: All source columns, headings, literal rate bands, units, rates, numerical zeroes, original formula strings and their cached values are in scope. Blank, numeric zero, slash, dash, newline-only text and a stored merged-subordinate string are distinct source states.

The main worksheet D/E/F headings retain the original base, ab 2024 and ab 2025 columns. Naturschutz retains F8 and every populated 2025 addition, even though its print area ends at E201. EBW retains both 2023 and ab 2024 tables and the explicit 2024 / ab 2025 Braunkehlchen and EBBA02 labels.
Alm NAW1-NAW3, NAD1-NAD3 and NAB1-NAB3, all Naturschutz code rows/groups/chapters and every EBW meadow, pasture, bird, arable and special-effort code/condition rate cell are included.

Every merged range is expected, including blank anchors. Original blank coordinates in explicitly bounded rate grids are independently recorded; blank years/conditions do not imply inheritance or zero rates.

All 14 explicit footer-note, attribution-note and correction-annotation cells are also expected as notes. Main A216:A218 preserves the full eco-scheme allocation, premium-band and guaranteed-minimum explanation. Hidden 2007 A179:A184 retains all five numbered explanations, with note 1 spanning two original cells.

Cell items retain all embedded land-area, slope, livestock, crop, date, quantity and participation limits. Regional/project references include main B161/C165/C167/B169/C178/B179/C181/B182/C212; Naturschutz C24/C144/C146/C147/C148/C153. These references are examples; every original populated cell is expected.

The hidden ÖPUL_2015 and ÖPUL_2007 worksheets are fully inventoried as historical original content. This includes the 16 stored merge-subordinate strings in 2015 and the four off-print 2007 cells IJ51/IK51/IN51/IO51; no display/print-area filter was applied.

Header/footer attribution text is retained verbatim in each sheet record. Archive inspection found no comments, drawings, hyperlinks, hidden rows/columns or external-link parts. Conditional formatting on the main sheet compares cells only with literal ! and x; it contains no additional rate text or numeric rate calculation.
source_limits: Completeness is limited to the exact SHA-256-bound ministerial workbook currently linked on 2026-10-11; this is not a claim that every legal premium provision, amendment, notice, local project confirmation or payment decision has been reviewed.

Publication/index currency does not convert ab 2024, ab 2025, 2023, ÖPUL 2015 or ÖPUL 2007 labels into 2026-specific legal applicability. Main and historical sheet headers still state Grünen Bericht 2023. These source labels are preserved rather than silently corrected.

The original leaves many year-column cells blank and uses rate ranges, slash and dash strings. No carry-forward rule, guaranteed payout above a printed minimum, interpolation, premium summation or binding eligibility interpretation is established by this inventory.

Three heading-row ROUND formulas reference original blank operands and have cached zero values: main E160/E170 and Naturschutz E171. They are preserved source anomalies and are not admitted as executable zero-rate facts.

The 16 occupied strings underneath merged cells on the hidden 2015 sheet are stored original content, not displayed heading text. Their apparently unrelated wording is not promoted to rate conditions or current applicability.

Naturschutz project-confirmation wording and placeholder $ values in C24/C146/C147/C148 remain unresolved original text. Regional Gebietskulisse and project-specific requirements require separate evidence before executable use.

Header/footer and raw XML layout metadata are inventory obligations outside the item-ID equality contract; source review must retain/compare these metadata and the independently listed rate-grid blank coordinates as well as every expected cell, merged-range and footnote ID.
